The Honest Shutdown
Game

The current evidence has been classified. Review its outcome and caveats before continuing.

The beacon stays dark. You hang a clear fault notice where a hopeful guess used to be. Even the enormous gate seems relieved to receive an honest answer.

The chapter closes with the damaged path isolated and the next work written down. There will be no celebration of a repair that has not happened. There can still be a next attempt.

Skip scene

Deliberate safe shutdown: the severed conduit remains disconnected and service is unresolved. Isolation is not restoration.

Named unresolved fault: the severed conduit remains disconnected. Deliberate isolation keeps that path out of service. Recovery plan: return to safe preparation, repair or replace the damaged path, then measure again and repeat the endpoint test. This is honest unresolved service, never a restoration.

No media route is recorded for this shutdown. The recovery record leaves that choice open rather than inventing a journey you did not take.

You faced the Rift with your own observations and a well-used toolkit.

The main journey has a chapter of its own.

Continue returns to safe encounter preparation in this temporary session. Preparation and inventory rewind; new clues, personal notes and hint-use history remain. Earlier measurements become stale and must be repeated.

Retry from Encounter Preparation is temporary session recovery, not a second save slot. Preparation and inventory rewind together. New clues, personal notes and hint-use history remain; earlier measurements become stale. Save later at an ordinary safe moment to keep that learning across sessions.

Restore Save loads the signed-in account's one saved snapshot. It replaces this in-memory adventure and its unsaved changes; it does not retain new learning from this attempt. Review that decision before loading.

This scene does not overwrite your account save. Terminal failure and unresolved shutdown cannot be saved or autosaved.

Guests can retry from the in-memory preparation checkpoint. Sign in before checking or loading an account save; signing in alone does not restore it.
